module purpose: neorv32_cpu_cp_fpu decodes FPU commands from ctrl_i, captures operands and control state, executes classify/compare/convert/sign-inject/min/max/add-subtract/multiply using local datapaths plus the supplied f2i and normalizer subunits, maintains rounding-mode and exception-flag CSRs, and reports the selected result on res_o with valid_o.

use-case flows.value: write the floating-point rounding-mode CSR and sticky exception-flag CSR from csr_wdata_i
decode a supported FPU instruction, latch function/operands/rounding mode, and start the selected functional unit
classify operands and execute compare, classify, min/max, sign-inject, integer/float conversion, add/subtract, multiply, and normalization
publish the completed operation result and completion indication, and capture per-operation exception flags
return the sticky exception flags, rounding mode, or combined fcsr value on csr_rdata_o
clear CSR state, control state, operand latches, result/flag registers, and completion state when rstn_i is low

conceptual assets.concept: Rounding mode used by FPU operations
conceptual assets.reasoning: CSR writes load csr_frm from csr_wdata_i at lines 286-292, and the control engine latches the active per-operation rounding mode into fpu_operands.frm from csr_frm when ctrl_i.ir_funct3 = "111" or directly from ctrl_i.ir_funct3 otherwise (lines 429-432). That latched mode is then delivered to the f2i and normalizer subunits (lines 697 and 1465) and is also used locally for add/subtract zero-sign handling (lines 1156-1178). Corrupting this setting changes conversion, normalization, and sign-selection behavior, so Integrity is established; Availability is also established by CSR readback on lines 306-307 and by capture at operation start.

The output gate captures the selected operation's flags into fflags when a result is accepted (lines 1495-1514), and csr_write accumulates sticky status with `csr_fflags <= csr_fflags or fflags` when no explicit CSR write occurs (line 295); CSR writes can also overwrite the status directly (lines 282-292). csr_read returns the flags or combined fcsr value on lines 305-307. Integrity is established because software-visible exception status must match the selected FU flags and the sticky-OR rule; Availability is established because csr_fflags is stored until overwritten or reset and can be read out.

conceptual assets.concept: Accepted FPU command for the current operation
conceptual assets.reasoning: Instruction fields are decoded into supported-operation bits, cmd.valid, and cmd.funct on lines 316-340. In S_IDLE, the control engine latches funct_ff and, when ctrl_i.alu_cp_fpu = '1' and cmd.valid = '1', asserts ctrl_engine.start and enters S_BUSY (lines 425-443). That start pulse fans out to the selected FU on lines 467-474, and funct_ff later selects both normalizer inputs (lines 1419-1447) and the output source (lines 1496-1514). If this decision or stored function code is corrupted, the wrong unit can be launched or the wrong result path can be selected; Availability is also established because the RTL explicitly launches an accepted command under the stated conditions.

conceptual assets.concept: Latched source operand values for the in-flight FPU operation
conceptual assets.reasoning: The module preprocesses rs1_i and rs2_i into op_data, zeroing the mantissa when the exponent field is zero (lines 347-353), then latches those operand values into fpu_operands.rs1 and fpu_operands.rs2 when an operation is accepted (lines 437-440). Those stored values are later consumed by comparison, min/max, sign injection, f2i conversion, multiplication, and add/subtract logic (for example lines 545-563, 673-676, 700-702, 716-726, 785-792, 851, and 1065-1236). Corruption makes the computed result or flags incorrect, and Availability is established because the operands are captured and held across multi-cycle execution.

conceptual assets.concept: Operand classification decisions for the active operands
conceptual assets.reasoning: The number_classifier process derives class bits for zero, normal, denormal, infinity, signaling NaN, and quiet NaN from op_data and the original mantissas on lines 358-395. Those class vectors are stored in fpu_operands.rs1_class and fpu_operands.rs2_class on lines 438-440, are returned by the classify operation on lines 483-486, and drive special-case behavior in compare/minmax/multiply/add-subtract logic (for example lines 503-579, 636-677, 774-839, 871-1023, 1080-1222, and 1263-1403). Wrong class decisions therefore change both reported classification and arithmetic/control corner-case handling.

conceptual assets.concept: Completed FPU result value delivered to the CPU
conceptual assets.reasoning: When ctrl_engine.valid is asserted, output_gate selects the completed result source by funct_ff and writes res_o from classify, compare, f2i, sign-inject, min/max, or normalizer outputs (lines 1495-1514). The underlying computations are visible in the compare result logic (lines 598-620), sign injection (lines 715-727), the f2i subunit output path (lines 705 and 2294), and the normalizer output path fed by add/subtract, multiply, or i2f preparation (lines 1419-1475 and 1884-1886). Integrity is established because res_o must match the selected operation's computed value; Availability is established because the result is registered and exported on completion. For fu_classify.result (lines 484-485) and fu_min_max.result (lines 672-677), the RTL shows result formatting/selection but the map retained only copied arms, so those references use edge null.

conceptual assets.concept: FPU completion indication for the current operation
conceptual assets.reasoning: The control engine clears ctrl_engine.valid each cycle and sets it in S_BUSY when either fu_core_done or ctrl_i.cpu_trap is true (lines 417-450). fu_core_done is the OR of the unit done signals on line 1521, valid_o copies ctrl_engine.valid on line 462, and output_gate only releases res_o and fflags when ctrl_engine.valid = '1' (line 1495). Integrity is established because consumers must see completion only for finished or trapped operations; Availability is established under the explicit done/trap conditions implemented in the RTL.
